description:
Advances: ancora.derive

Severity: Medium (calibrated; critical review 2026-09-05, consolidated F26, spec). Evidence: ancora.derive.memo_is_run_scoped says derived state shall not live in a memo, registry, cache, or new process, while the parallel-parsing statements added by ancora-gg8.7 mandate Task.async_stream workers (new processes) for parsing. Both are true in intent (no cross-run state vs concurrent stateless workers) but the text reads as contradictory. Scoping or splitting a stable must needs an ADR (amend ancora.decision.no_run_context_memo or add one). Ready-for: investigate.
title: memo_is_run_scoped forbids a new process and mandates concurrency in adjacent sentences
